snippet.title: Torebia Island Public Playtest 2 Announcement
snippet.description:
Join our discord: https://discord.gg/Ncmftxfp9V
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768880/?utm_source=youtube

Built for players who want challenge, community, and freedom—Torebia focuses on combat, exploration, and player-driven builds without chores or filler.

Key Features

- A World of Islands — Sail between unique islands, each a distinct biome with monsters, dungeons, and secrets. New lands await those bold enough to seek them.
- Player-Driven Builds — No fixed classes. Mix archetypes freely: Berserk, Hunter, Mage, Priest, Rogue, Blacksmith, Alchemist, Butcher, Paladin, and Warlock.
- Guild Ranks — Rise from Bronze to Mythic. Your rank unlocks new regions, harder challenges, and greater rewards.
- Trade & Economy — Everything is tradeable. Craft, gather, and sell freely—no item binding or artificial restrictions.
- Shared World — One persistent archipelago with rare spawns, open dungeons, and world bosses for everyone to contest.
- Combat First — Tight, challenging combat. Gear matters. Skill matters. No pay-to-win.
- Lean Design — No daily chores or bloat. Every system serves one purpose: adventure.
